context.transcript:
Hi. My name is Andrew, and I'll be your server today.
Are you ready to order?
Oh, not yet. I'm waiting for my colleague to arrive.
She's running behind because of the construction on
Lawrence Avenue — it's being repaved. There is one
thing I wanted to ask about, though. I don't see the
grilled swordfish listed on the menu.
Sorry, that dish is offered only on weekends. But we
do have a daily special that I can recommend.
context.transcript_translation:
你好，我叫安德鲁，今天由我为您服务。准备好点餐了吗？
哦，还没有。我在等同事到。劳伦斯大道正在施工重铺路面，所以她晚点了。不过，我确实有件事想问。我在菜单上没有看到烤剑鱼。
抱歉，那道菜只在周末供应。不过我们有每日特餐，我可以向您推荐。
